entities.name: Timer T302
entities.description: Timer T302 used for access barring control. When it expires or is stopped, barring for Access Categories (where T390 is not running) is alleviated.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer T390 associated with specific Access Categories. Expiry or stopping of T390 alleviates barring for the corresponding Access Category under certain conditions.

entities.name: Access Category
entities.description: Identifies different categories of access (e.g., '2', '8') subject to barring. Barring alleviation is per Access Category.

entities.name: Barring Alleviation
entities.description: Condition where barring for an Access Category is considered alleviated, triggering notification to upper layers or specific actions.

entities.name: Upper Layers Notification
entities.description: Procedure to inform upper layers about barring alleviation for an Access Category that was previously informed as barred.

entities.name: Actions in 5.3.13.8
entities.description: Specific actions performed when barring is alleviated for Access Category '2' or '8', as defined in clause 5.3.13.8.

relations.description: Expiry or stopping of T302 establishes barring alleviation for Access Categories where T390 is not running.
Expiry or stopping of T390 for an Access Category establishes barring alleviation for that category, subject to T302 not running (for categories other than '2').
Barring alleviation for an Access Category that was informed as barred establishes notification to upper layers.
Barring alleviation for Access Category '2' or '8' establishes execution of actions specified in clause 5.3.13.8.
Barring alleviation is guarded by the specific Access Category (e.g., '2' or '8') for which conditions are met.
